B: Magnitude through the B (blue) filter, in the color index B − V
M: Absolute magnitude: the magnitude seen from 10 pc
M_ridge: Absolute magnitude of the calibrated ridge line at that color
V: Apparent magnitude through the V (visual) filter
V_i: Apparent V magnitude of star i
b: Linear coefficient of the quadratic fit of mean square offset against shift
c: Quadratic coefficient of the quadratic fit of mean square offset against shift
i: Number of a star in the cluster
mu: Shift of the cluster, its trial distance modulus m − M
o_i: Offset of star i from the ridge line at the shift μ
sigma_M: Spread (standard deviation) of M among nearby stars of one spectral type
